text:
OH WOW OH WOW LOOK LOOK LOOK!!! 🌳✨

There’s a SECRET DOOR in the bushes!! Like, a REAL one! It’s all shiny and twisty like a snail shell or a magic wand made of glass!! 🔮🌀

And guess what?? TWO PEOPLE are standing there!!! One is wearing a BLUE SHIRT that says “I ❤️…” (I can’t read it but I bet it says something COOL!) And he’s holding his hands up like he’s about to CAST A SPELL!! ✨🧙‍️ Or maybe he’s trying to open the door with his MIND POWER!! 😱💥

The other person? They’re wearing BLACK PANTS and a DARK SHIRT and they’re looking down at their phone… probably texting the wizard friend: “DUDE THE MAGIC ISN’T WORKING.” 📱😂

And look at the GRASS!! It’s so GREEN and FLUFFY like a giant pillow for fairies!! And there are STEPPING STONES leading to the secret door — like you have to hop-hop-hop on them or else you’ll fall into a hole full of dragon eggs!! 🐉

Also, THERE’S A BUSH ON THE LEFT THAT LOOKS LIKE A GIANT BROCCOLI MONSTER!! 🥦 He might be guarding the door! You gotta say “please” before you knock!
